attchmntText: Ajooni Biotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ajooni Biotech Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 51.10 lakhs, compared to 43.18 lakhs in the same period last year. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 6,536.95 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net profit was 94.28 lakhs. Revenue from operations for the half year was 12,886.02 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was 0.02 rupees. The company has a single segment. The limited review report from the auditor was also approved. The results are subject to Regulation 33 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.
